## In short

Written claims get answers; phone calls rarely do.

## How complaints actually go

- Written complaints are answered within 30 days. [Example Air complaints page](https://www.example.com/contact)

## What tends to work

- Citing the refund rule gets cash refunds approved. [DOT](https://www.example.gov/rule)
- Reported by customers: asking for the claims desk speeds things up. [Forum thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/example/comments/1)

## Traps and fine print

- Accepting a voucher can end the right to a cash refund. [Contract of carriage](https://www.example.com/legal/contract-of-carriage)

## Scams that target customers

- Fake Example Air numbers appear in search ads. [Example Air security](https://www.example.com/security)
